body:
This is storage release [storage-v0.2.0](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/releases/tag/storage-v0.2.0) for commit [ff81f99bb1c07e842df29e08f8db34ad08929ae2](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/ff81f99bb1c07e842df29e08f8db34ad08929ae2).

## What's Changed

Storage release with 1 feature, 2 fixes.

### Features

- Add landing demo video. ([5708194](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/5708194f65c884e4cd45dfb6485182a018983f49))

### Fixes

- Require manage access for shared roots. ([ff81f99](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/ff81f99bb1c07e842df29e08f8db34ad08929ae2))
- Allow folder-level uploads. ([bf42594](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/bf42594cef8d182ec7fbdb6e01ee22f10c29a3f1))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/compare/storage-v0.1.0...storage-v0.2.0

```sh
git checkout ff81f99bb1c07e842df29e08f8db34ad08929ae2
npm install -g @icp-sdk/icp-cli@1.0.0 @icp-sdk/ic-wasm ic-mops@2.14.1
apps/backend/scripts/build-storage-release-wasm.sh
shasum -a 256 apps/backend/.icp/cache/artifacts/encrypted-storage
```

The machine-readable release contract is attached as `storage-release.json`.
